prompt:
Goal: Create a vertical anime-style 9-panel slice-of-life comic page about two teenage girls making a short video/photo story in a sunny park, with playful acting, candid reactions, and a final framed photo reveal.

Canvas: Tall vertical page, approximately 9:16, divided into a clean 3-column by 3-row grid with narrow white gutters. Bright daytime lighting, soft cel-shaded anime rendering, detailed park background with green trees, wooden benches, gravel path, and occasional black lamp posts.

Main characters: Use exactly 2 recurring girls in every panel. Girl A is the energetic blonde girl: short pale-blonde bob haircut with side bangs and small hair clips, big blue eyes, expressive cheerful face, petite build. Girl B is the cool dark-haired girl: very long straight dark navy-purple hair with subtle reddish highlights, calm half-lidded blue-purple eyes, taller slim build, composed and slightly aloof. Both wear matching school-inspired outfits: white button-up shirts with black neckties/ribbon ties, black shorts or slim black pants, belts, and chunky black high-top boots; Girl A has neon green laces and Girl B has pink laces.

Panel count and layout: Create exactly 9 discrete panels.
1. Top-left: Girl A crouches near a small smartphone on a mini tripod, excitedly setting up the shot; Girl B sits calmly on a park bench in the background.
2. Top-center: Girl A adjusts Girl B's pose and tie/arms, leaning in with enthusiasm while Girl B stands with crossed arms and a mildly annoyed expression.
3. Top-right: Both girls pose confidently in front of the bench, Girl B arms crossed, Girl A hands on hips; the phone/tripod is visible low in the foreground, aimed at them.
4. Middle-left: Close-up of the two on the bench; Girl A blushes and giggles with one hand near her mouth while Girl B looks sideways with a deadpan, unimpressed expression.
5. Middle-center: Both girls act startled and comedic, with raised hands, sweat-drop reaction marks, and exaggerated surprise; Girl A bends forward laughing or flailing while Girl B recoils.
6. Middle-right: Close-up of a hand holding a black smartphone vertically; the phone screen displays the same startled pose from panel 5, as if recorded or photographed.
7. Bottom-left: Girl A holds up the smartphone for a selfie or review while sitting beside Girl B on the bench; Girl B covers her mouth laughing, both relaxed and playful.
8. Bottom-center: Both girls sit on the bench laughing together, legs visible with their colorful boot laces prominent, warm friendly mood.
9. Bottom-right: Girl B sits in the foreground holding a wooden picture frame toward the viewer; inside the frame is the funny startled image from panel 5. Girl B wears a subtle smug smile, while Girl A pops up behind her with an embarrassed shocked face and hands on her head.

Visual style: Modern Japanese anime illustration, clean line art, soft pastel colors, crisp character designs, expressive manga faces, light comedic motion marks, bright leafy bokeh background, polished digital painting. Emphasize cute friendship energy and short-story continuity between panels.

Text content: No speech bubbles, no captions, no visible written text.

Constraints: Use exactly 2 characters and exactly 9 panels. Keep the same outfits, hairstyles, shoe lace colors, and park location consistent across all panels. Include exactly 2 visible devices/props used repeatedly: a black smartphone and a wooden picture frame. Do not add extra characters, vehicles, logos, watermarks, or readable text.
